quest.title: Wangshu Take-Away
quest.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Eh? Sure, sure. I'll find someone else. Worse come to worst, I'll do it myself.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Make sure you <color=#00E1FFFF>avoid monsters at all costs. If you get any weird elements on your person or take a hard knock, that food's toast</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Needless to say, if the food's ruined, the customer isn't taking it.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright, then, run along. Don't keep the customer waiting, now.

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: I've been strolling around here for so long. I wonder why my meal hasn't arrived yet...

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Well, better late than never... Mm, this Almond Tofu looks great.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: Thanks a lot! Hehe... after all that walking, it's great to finally have something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: That they did, alright. There's a guest lodging here named Ling'guan. She ordered a serving of Almond Tofu a while earlier and, after paying, wanted me to deliver it to someplace north of Dihua Marsh.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: But we've been really busy here at the inn, and I haven't the time to go out and deliver the food myself. If you could help me out, that would be great. I'll be sure to compensate you fairly.

dialogues.speaker: Laid Back Ling'guan
dialogues.text: I've been strolling around here for so long. I wonder why my meal hasn't arrived yet...
